Dietzsch used stuffed specimens as models, and often exaggerated their beauty. Here, she emphasized the liveliness of the bird, with one claw lifted, the beak slightly open, and a knowing twinkle in its eye.
Born and active in Nuremberg, Germany, Barbara Dietzsch became widely known in her lifetime for botanical drawings. Rarer are her depictions of birds, two of which are displayed in this gallery.
